sections.description:
Short title and commencement

Act XII Of 2005
Act XII Of 2005
N.W.F.P (Amendment Of Laws) Act 2005
An Act To Amend Certain Laws
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P Extraordinary 5th
August, 2005]
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province
(Amendment of Laws) Act, 2005.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.
